parts.text: A student collected some water from a polluted river. The water contained soluble solids and insoluble clay and had a pH of 5.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) How can the student separate the clay from the rest of the river water? [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student uses litmus paper to show that the river water is acidic. What will be the result of this test? [1]

parts.label: c
